settings.ollamaHint: ⚠️ Ollama must be running, and the model above must be pulled beforehand: ollama pull {{model}}. Ollama manages the model file path, so you don't need to set it.
settings.saveAnywayHint: If you'll start Ollama later, or it's a temporary error
settings.enrichNowHint: Press to generate summaries and tags now (requires backend setup and connection).
settings.keyApplyHint: Saved keys apply from the next enrichment run (scheduled or manual).
settings.embedHint: To re-embed from scratch, use "Full re-index" on the current model; to switch models, use "Change".
settings.reindexPreparing: Preparing… (progress shows once the first embedding batch starts)
settings.reindexFailed: Couldn't start re-indexing. Please try again.
settings.embedTip: If your device is slow or low on RAM, we recommend a lighter model (MiniLM) — far less time and RAM (slightly lower quality). On a high-end device with plenty of RAM, "Fast re-index (parallel)" can cut the time when re-indexing.
settings.reindexDescCurrent: Using {{model}} (current model), this discards all existing vectors and re-embeds every conversation from scratch. The model stays the same, so there's no download.
settings.reindexDescChange: Switching to {{model}} discards all existing vectors and re-embeds every conversation. Vectors live in a different coordinate space per model and can't be mixed, so a full re-index is required.
settings.reindexTail: Estimated: re-index ~{{min}}m (on this device){{download}}. Uses ~{{ram}}GB RAM while embedding. Search quality may dip temporarily in the meantime. Continue?
settings.reindexDownload: + first download of the new model, ~{{size}}GB
settings.fastReindexDesc: Fast re-index (parallel) — no re-parsing; split across several processes to go faster. Each process loads the model, so it uses a lot of RAM.
settings.ramOver: Exceeds available RAM — lower parallelism to {{recMax}} or fewer (it's auto-capped if exceeded).
settings.indexModeHint_off: Auto-indexing is off. Run it manually with “Index now” below when needed.
settings.indexModeHint_interval: Automatically indexes new conversations on the interval you set (minutes).
settings.indexModeHint_realtime: Indexes new conversations automatically as soon as they appear (within seconds).
settings.indexModeHint_scheduled: Indexes once a day at the time you set.

onboarding.title: Choose an embedding model
onboarding.desc: To search your conversations by meaning, you need an embedding model. Pick the one that fits your device — indexing starts with it, and you can change it anytime in settings (a full re-index).
onboarding.errorDetail: The app (backend) may still be starting up. Please try again in a moment.
onboarding.pickFailed: Couldn't select that model. Please try again.
onboarding.help1: Once you pick, that model downloads (lighter models are faster) and indexing begins. If you are unsure, just pick the model with the "Recommended for this device" badge.
onboarding.help2: For 32GB or more, we recommend int8 e5-large (higher quality, bundled); below that, a lightweight model (MiniLM).

mcp.sectionTitle: MCP Integration (let other AIs search past conversations)
mcp.loadFailedHint: The app may still be starting up.

sync.onNote: ✓ On — conflicts are now resolved automatically (leave it on)
sync.explain: When you continue the same conversation on multiple devices at once, a conflict can occasionally arise. Leave this on and the app resolves them automatically — it keeps the longer conversation and preserves a new session only when things have genuinely diverged. If you use Device connection above, we recommend leaving it on.
sync.engineStarting: Starting engine… (the first run downloads it and takes a moment)
sync.engineIdleHint: Connect devices with the engine built into the app — no separate Syncthing install needed. Press "Start" to get ready.
sync.myCodeLabel: My connection code (paste it on the other device)
sync.pastePeerLabel: Paste the other device's code → connect
sync.pairSent: ✓ Connection request sent — syncing starts once the other app accepts
sync.pairHelp:
Enter each other's code on both devices and connect, and ~/.claude/projects syncs automatically. If the other app shows a "new device/folder request," accept it.
· On the first connection, if a firewall permission popup appears, choose Allow (needed for network communication).
· Deletions and overwrites are automatically kept in history (up to 1 year), so you can recover from mistakes.
sync.folderPreparing: Preparing shared folder — it shares automatically once a device connects
sync.stateError: Sync error — check the firewall and folder settings below
sync.mergeImported: ✓ Imported {{count}} conversation(s) from other devices — indexing/embedding soon
sync.mergeUpToDate: Already up to date — nothing new to import
sync.mergeHelp: Claude Code deletes old logs (~30 days), but each device's Engram preserves conversations from before then. This merge pulls in the old conversations other devices preserved so your search history lines up (connected devices also do this automatically). Sessions whose originals were deleted can't be resumed, but remain searchable and viewable.

schema.title: Report a problem (log format)
schema.intro: When a tool updates and its log format changes, conversations may become unreadable. You can generate a report that includes only structural info, never conversation content, and send it as a GitHub issue.
schema.previewNote: Only the content below is sent (no conversations). Review it, then send the issue.
